defs.def: to continue to be in a particular place for a period of time without moving away 停留；待

ex.s: To stay warm, she ran her engine for a few minutes every now and then.
ex.t: 为了保暖，她时不时把引擎发动几分钟。

ex.s: Even in middle school I would stay up very late.

ex.s: About half of Ho’s students stay for a week or less; others are there for more than a year.

ex.s: Pollinators: To Leave or to StayB.

ex.s: If I had to make just one recommendation for where to stay in Rome, it would be Yellow Hostel.

ex.s: Trip includes round-trip air tickets, hotel stay for two nights, and tours of the National Air and Space Museum and the office of National Geographic World.

ex.s: They could stay long underwater.

ex.t: 我们一起玩游戏熬夜读睡前故事。

ex.t: 事实上，我们和十年前一样住在同一个营地。

ex.s: The Moldovan has lived here seven years as a caregiver to Italian kids and the elderly, but in order to stay she’s had to prove her language skills by taking a test which requires her to write a postcard to an imaginary friend and answer a fictional job ad.
ex.t: 这位摩尔多瓦人作为意大利孩子和老人的照护者已在这里住了七年，但为了留下来，她必须通过一项测试来证明自己的语言能力——测试要求她给一个想象中的朋友写明信片，并回复一则虚构的招聘广告。

ex.s: Stay for as little or as long as your plans allow.

ex.s: "We were so amazed that they could stay underwater much longer than us local islanders," Dr Jubilado said.

defs.def: to continue to be in a particular state or situation 保持；继续是

ex.s: Too much praise can backfire and, when given in a way that's insincere, make kids afraid to try new things or take a risk for fear of not being able to stay on top where their parents' praise has put them.
ex.t: 过多的表扬可能适得其反，而且当表扬以不真诚的方式给出时，会让孩子害怕尝试新事物或冒险，担心无法保持在父母表扬把他们放到的那个顶端位置。

ex.s: About 100 of these stayed rich men for the rest of their lives.
ex.t: 其中大约100人余生都保持着富人的身份。

ex.s: It will stay for a decade.
ex.t: 75   "你会保留重要的东西，"托尼说。

ex.t: 本科生Jessica Pink建议与朋友一起参加在线课程，这样你们就可以激励彼此保持正轨。

ex.s: Then, when you use one section,   64   other stays fresh.

ex.s: Stay loose and free.

ex.s: Challenging work that requires lots of analytical thinking, planning and other managerial skills might help your brain stay sharp as you age, a study published Wednesday in the journal Neurology suggests.

ex.s: Despite the pain, I stayed the course walking a bit and then running again.
ex.t: 尽管疼痛，我坚持了下来，走了一会儿然后又跑起来。

ex.s: The damage is usually more serious on the first plant, but the neighbors, relatively speaking, stay safer because they heard the alarm and knew what to do.
ex.t: 第一株植物受到的伤害通常更为严重，但相比之下，邻居们因为听到了警报而知道该怎么做，所以更加安全。

ex.s: The team discovered that some synapses seem to be protected and stayed the same size.
ex.t: 研究团队发现，某些突触似乎受到保护，保持了相同的尺寸。

ex.s: Nowadays, we can move around the world and still stay in touch with the people that we want to remain friends with.

ex.s: Your application will be accessed by UNESCO managers and will stay in our database for six months．We do not respond to every candidate．If selected，you will be contacted by a manager．If you do not receive any update within six months，it means that your application has not been successful．
